• [...] Where Chatwoot typically centers on web chat and a unified inbox across channels, ClearFeed optimizes for the reality of B2B support happening inside shared Slack channels. It can detect and track requests in conversations, help teams triage and follow up, and bring SLA discipline to a medium that’s otherwise easy to lose track of.

It’s also a strong fit for companies supporting many customer channels at once, because it helps prevent missed threads and makes it easier to manage outstanding issues across dozens of workspaces or channels. For teams that already run a ticketing system, ClearFeed can complement that workflow through integrations, letting Slack be the front door without sacrificing process.
